results.title: Shana
results.overview: Shana navigates the trials and tribulations of everyday life with boundless energy and the support of her group of friends. When her grandmother passes away, she inherits a ring that is supposed to protect her from bad luck. Shana certainly needs this helping hand. Especially since her toxic partner has been released from prison, and misfortunes are piling up…

results.title: Hell Hath No Fury
results.overview: When Aidan, an agnostic psychiatrist, is turned away from his grieving wife by a mysterious temptress, he discovers their story may be eons in the making.

results.title: RARE
results.overview: A man’s dream first date is put at risk when intense headaches threaten to disrupt the moment.

results.title: Tear Your Eyes Away From The Screen
results.original_title: Despega los ojos de la pantalla
results.overview: Time passes, but Cándido doesn't care. Scrolling through the screen of his cell phone, he has all the answers to the mysteries of the universe in front of him. The only answer he can't find, however, is the exact moment of his impending doom.

results.title: Spinned
results.overview: A pair of undercover agents are assigned to protect a princess from an ancient curse. When the mission fails, they lose their jobs — just as the kingdom's most wicked villains return. Forced to clear their names, the duo sets off on a hilarious chase through fairy-tale worlds to break the curse and catch the true mastermind.

results.title: Cerimônia
results.overview: When I first moved in with friends, it became a habit to have people over all the time.

results.title: Sea of Glass
results.overview: 65-year-old Vangelio decides to go on holiday after her husband's death. In a run-down off-season seaside resort she meets Vicky, a young woman caring for her alcoholic father. When Vangelio protects Vicky from her father's violence, chaos erupts in their seaside town.

results.title: Rumi Di Sebalik Jendela
results.overview: Their initially tense relationship turns into a close one, until feelings of love arise. However, everything becomes complicated when Rumi finds out Mira's true status.

results.title: When I Said I Do
results.overview: Ali Corley is a widowed search-and-rescue K-9 handler who rebuilt her life after losing her husband in the line of duty. When she meets seasoned rescue specialist Shawn Willis, their connection forces them both to confront the true meaning of commitment.

results.title: London Ghost
results.overview: A woman is blindfolded and whisked away by friends for a birthday celebration. When a voice from the past resurfaces, the line between surprise and trap quickly starts to blur.

results.title: Charlie Is Not a Boy
results.overview: Charlie is Not a Boy is the tale of a hushed soul, bound to a crumbling household in an allegorical America. With a perverted butcher for a father and a mother frozen in a quiet, catatonic spell, Charlie seeks solace in the whimsical world of his eccentric grandmother. As his safe haven unravels, Charlie navigates the hostile worlds of home and the military, caught between his authentic self and the masks he must wear.

results.title: On March 12 And Every Day After
results.original_title: Am 12. März Und Alle Tage Danach
results.overview: A STORY ABOUT LOVE AND VIOLENCE. Linz, 12 March 1938: Milena, a young communist, is in a secret relationship with the seamstress Anne. Faced with the Austrofascist government under Schuschnigg and the Nazi invasion, she is at a loss as to whether she should stay with Anne in Linz or return to her family in Southern Carinthia. As she is trying to figure out what to do, she meets Johann, a soldier in the Wehrmacht, who is very keen to get to know her better.

results.title: Sunburn
results.overview: When a citywide blackout knocks out the power on one of the hottest days on record, a group of neighborhood kids set out in search of relief, unaware that the day will quietly mark the end of their childhood.

results.title: Widerhall
results.overview: In the wake of tragedy, renowned musician Daniel García wrestles with grief, and with the music that defined his career, through a new passion project.

results.title: Where to Find Foxes
results.overview: A new mother, kept awake by the sound of foxes prowling outside her home, ventures into the night to scare them off only to find herself a part of a strange and feral ritual.

results.title: Echoes of the Unseen
results.overview: Amidst the carnival’s roar, Ardo follows Ladya searching for a lost necklace. Together, they weave a fleeting sanctuary, before reality pulls Ardo away, leaving Ladya to fade into the lights.

results.title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Space Busted
results.original_title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Space Busted
results.overview: Supergirl takes Krypto the Superdog on an adventure into space! Can he save the aliens he meets along the way?

results.title: Never Crossed the Mind
results.overview: In the heart of Luxor, Younes embarks on a romantic and comedic adventure when he becomes in charge of a multinational tourist group. While he tries to communicate with them in four different languages, he falls in love with a girl in the middle of ancient temples, and encounters funny situations that prove that the language of the heart is the truest, no matter how different the tongues are.

results.title: Magic Hour
results.overview: Erin and Charlie escape to the desert to navigate an unexpected and challenging new phase of their relationship.

results.title: Dark Places
results.overview: A troubled college student, Natalie Parker, befriends the mysterious Jason Evans, only to be pulled into a world of satanic murder, family trauma, and psychological unraveling
